facts.note: Sat alone in the dining room with brandy after dinner; when the temple struck ten, his watch showed four minutes to ten.
Went out into the street to smoke at twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch, and stayed under the front windows of the house.
Piano started in the salon just as he lit his cigar, at twenty-nine minutes past ten by his watch; it stopped at eighteen minutes to eleven by his watch.
At twenty-six minutes to eleven by his watch he heard faint quick bells from the master's window above, with the piano playing all the while.
Came back into the house at fourteen minutes to eleven by his watch; the hall clock had just struck eleven and showed two minutes past eleven; he then went up to Félix in the library.
